items.title: House Gapfohl / Bernardo Bader Architekten
items.summary: The architectural concept of the primordial hut can be traced back to Vitruvius. As an idealized model of the natural dwelling, it had a profound influence on architectural theory in the eighteenth century, most notably through Marc-Antoine Laugier.

items.title: Brugge Diptych / PARA
items.summary: Brugge Diptych is a temporary pavilion commissioned for the 2021 Brugge Triennale. Set along a quiet residential canal, it abuts an abandoned fifteenth-century house in a dense UNESCO-protected neighborhood.
